evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Scope and behavior are specific and implementable; a reasonable estimate can be made.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded functionality (generate/share URL) that can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Concrete UI/action; small, estimatable scope.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Clearly scoped display/listing feature; can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Specific selection behavior; implementation size is estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Simple CRUD action, bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Specific edit functionality; straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Clear delete operation; reasonable to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Behavior is specific (reveal early) and can be estimated (UI and rule change).

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Clear calculation/accept action; implementable and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Specific trigger and behavior; scope is small and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Explicit action (enter agreed estimate); implementable with clear scope.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Clear re-estimation capability; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Common, bounded feature (import); details (formats) can be chosen without preventing a reasonable estimate.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Specific mechanism (copy/paste) with limited scope; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing/listing capability is concrete and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Clear feature (view transcript) with definable scope; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Specific export format and behavior; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Clear export requirement and format; can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Delete semantics are clear enough to estimate (remove persisted data), though implementation detail (soft vs hard) can be decided in design.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Concrete registration fields and flow; easily estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Standard, well-bounded authentication feature; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Typical profile update functionality; scope is clear enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is a concrete action; estimation possible (may require acceptance criteria but not needed to estimate rough size).

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display behavior is well-scoped and implementable; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Standard password reset/email flow; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Specifies two preset scales; implementable as selectable presets despite 'etc.' — scope is bounded enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Explicit numeric cap; feature scope is clear and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Simple join flow with clear input; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Clear UI requirement to display the current item; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Listing feature with clear scope; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Specific visual feedback requirement; implementable and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear synchronization behavior; scope is concrete enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Well-defined condition for allowing changes; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Feature is specific enough (show prior estimates for the same story) to estimate implementation effort.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Explicit display requirement with clear scope; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Specific timer duration and shared display; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear trigger and behavior for timer reset; implementable and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Clear browsing feature across prior rounds; scope is estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Deterministic UI ordering requirement; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Clear condition for editing; small, estimatable scope.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI enhancement with clear scope; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is a measurable target (specific standards implied); scope is definable for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Vague: number of terms, which terms, and level of detail are unspecified making it hard to estimate effort.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified: does not identify which queries/tables or target performance; 'as fast as possible' is ambiguous, preventing a reasonable estimate.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Explicit list of target browsers gives clear scope for testing/fixes; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Broad and vague ('where possible') — accessibility guidelines are extensive and compliance targets are unspecified, making effort hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Undefined acceptance criterion ('quickly') and no target metrics provided, so implementation effort cannot be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Clear technical requirement (Unicode support); scope is straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Although subjective, the scope (human-friendly URLs) is narrow enough to estimate implementation effort.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: UI/UX feature with bounded scope (error pages); implementable and estimatable despite 'nice' being subjective.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified privacy/anonymization requirements (which fields, level of anonymization, re-identification risk) — too vague to estimate reliably.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: 'Some metrics' is unspecified (which metrics, aggregation, retention); scope is too vague to produce a reasonable implementation estimate.
